text:
Mild steel is galvanised to prevent corrosion of the iron.
Which statements about galvanising are correct?
1
Galvanising prevents corrosion because the zinc forms an alloy.
2
If the coating is damaged, water and oxygen do not corrode the iron.
3
Zinc is a sacrificial metal and corrodes in preference to iron.
A
1 and 2
B
1 and 3
C
2 only
D
2 and 3
subject: Chemistry
